properties.name: enterprise.governance.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable database governance layer.

properties.name: enterprise.governance.cache-size
properties.description: Maximum size of the governance decision cache.

properties.name: enterprise.governance.use-sql-parser
properties.description: Enable SQL parsing for better rule evaluation.

properties.name: enterprise.governance.block-unsafe-deletes
properties.description: Block DELETE/UPDATE statements without WHERE clause.

properties.name: enterprise.governance.block-schema-changes
properties.description: Block schema modification statements (DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER).

properties.name: enterprise.governance.warn-select-all
properties.description: Warn when SELECT * is used in queries.
